div.div: Zoom levels: repo and services → packages and modules → files → symbols, disclosed progressively. Nodes: internal module, external package, service, database table, config key, API endpoint, message topic. Edges: imports, calls, inherits and implements, reads and writes table, HTTP, gRPC and IPC calls, FFI, config use, test covers. Cycles highlighted; rules such as “UI must not depend on the database” are checked

text.tspan: Zoom levels: repo and services → packages and modules → files
→ symbols, disclosed progressively. Nodes: internal module,
external package, service, database table, config key, API
endpoint, message topic. Edges: imports, calls, inherits and
implements, reads and writes table, HTTP, gRPC and IPC calls, FFI,
config use, test covers. Cycles highlighted; rules such as “UI must
not depend on the database” are checked
